title: Sprint Contract Entry
description: One line of specs/_epic/contracts.jsonl. Append-only log of per-sprint contracts negotiated between generator and evaluator. Lifecycle: agreed (after negotiation) -> completed (after evaluator QA passes) -> amended (rare, only when implementation reveals a contract issue and evaluator approves the amendment). Each line is independent JSON. Verification is split into two gates: inner_gate (run by the generator before commit, all-mock, no real external dependency) and outer_gate (run by the evaluator at VERIFY against the real running app + real dependencies). This split mirrors the generator/evaluator test-division: the generator self-verifies logic; the evaluator is the adversarial judge that uses the app.

contract_id.description: Contract identifier. Format: C-S{NN}-v{N} where S{NN} matches sprint id and v{N} is the negotiation revision (v1 first agreement, v2+ if amended). Same contract_id appears across phase transitions.

sprint.description: Sprint id this contract covers. Must match a sprint in spec.md sprint plan.

phase.description: Lifecycle state. agreed: negotiation done, generator may begin implementation. completed: evaluator QA passed all thresholds. amended: contract was revised mid-sprint (a new entry with same contract_id and incremented v in contract_id captures the amendment).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this entry was appended.

features_covered.description: F-ids from spec.md this sprint delivers. Required for phase=agreed. Must equal the spec.md sprint's Delivers: list verbatim.

done_looks_like.description: Human-readable bulleted statements of what 'done' means for this sprint. Each statement is a behavioral outcome, not an implementation note. For module-touching sprints, generator ALSO includes one item per module touched using the canonical embedding shape from deep-module-handbook references/generator-slice.md §1.5 (carrying hides_decision, applicability, entry-point budget, Strategy seam, broad interface, bounded context, optional deletion-test pre-commitment). Required for phase=agreed.

inner_gate.description: Checks the GENERATOR runs itself before committing. All-mock / hermetic: no real external dependency, no real network. The generator emits _pending/S{NN}-inner-gate-R{IR}.json reporting pass/fail per inner_gate step id. GREEN on every step is the sole precondition for the generator's single commit. The evaluator at VERIFY trusts this artifact (Phase 0) and does NOT re-run unit tests; it re-runs an inner step itself only when the artifact is missing or reports RED. Required for phase=agreed.

outer_gate.description: Steps the EVALUATOR runs at VERIFY against the real running app and real dependencies. Phased and dependency-ordered: env steps run first, then integration, then e2e, then matrix. A step whose depends_on prerequisite FAILed is marked SKIP, not executed. An env-class failure (permission denied, service unreachable, missing durable resource) carries on_fail: escalate. Required for phase=agreed.

^.+$.description: outer_gate step ids that contribute evidence for this criterion.

criterion_mapping.description: Maps each of the 4 evaluation criteria (from spec.md) to the outer_gate step ids that exercise it. All 4 criteria from spec.md MUST appear as keys, verbatim case-sensitive. The 4 criteria are evaluator-owned, so the mapping references outer_gate ids only. Required for phase=agreed.

inner_gate_must_pass.description: The inner gate is binary: every inner_gate step must be GREEN before the generator may commit. Always 'all'.

matrix_must_pass.description: The matrix sensor is binary per category; partial credit is not meaningful. Always 'all'.

per_criterion.description: Optional per-criterion threshold overrides. Default is 'all required-pass' for hard criteria.

thresholds.description: Hard thresholds for sprint completion. Any threshold below pass = sprint FAIL = generator gets feedback. Required for phase=agreed.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to runtime evidence (Claude Code transcript slice) that backs this completion. Required for phase=completed.

amendment_reason.description: Why the contract was amended (e.g., 'env step og-01 found a required service is created on-demand by the runtime and cannot be provisioned ahead of time'). Required for phase=amended.

inner_step.description: One generator-run pre-commit check. Hermetic: all-mock, no real external dependency. The generator's _pending/S{NN}-inner-gate-R{IR}.json artifact reports {passed, checks[], failures[]} keyed by these ids.

id.description: Inner-gate step id, unique within this contract.

kind.description: lint: format + static lint. typecheck: type checker. unit: unit test runner — MUST be all-mock (no real external service, no real network); a unit step that reaches a real service is a contract violation. smoke: app boots and a health endpoint returns 200 (still local — no real external dependency under test).

description.description: What this check covers, in one line.

outer_step.description: One evaluator-run VERIFY step against the real running app / real dependencies. Phased and dependency-ordered.

id.description: Outer-gate step id, unique within this contract. Referenced by criterion_mapping and by depends_on.

kind.description: env: environment precondition — credentials present, required permissions, real services reachable, durable resources exist (per RUNBOOK.md). integration: real dependency exercised from a code/API entry point (e.g., a test hitting a real service). playwright: end-to-end exercised from the browser entry point via Playwright (a real dependency is its precondition, not its classifier — a browser-entry test is e2e even when it needs a real datastore). matrix: deterministic sensor (perf/race/locale/sca/secret/mutation/interface-stability). manual: human-style judgement, rare, only for vision/aesthetic criteria.

phase.description: Verification phase. The evaluator runs phases in order env -> integration -> e2e -> matrix. kind=env -> phase env; kind=integration -> phase integration; kind=playwright -> phase e2e; kind=matrix -> phase matrix; kind=manual -> phase e2e. matrix-phase steps always run regardless of earlier-phase failures.

depends_on.description: outer_gate step ids that must PASS before this step is executed. If any prerequisite FAILed or was SKIPped, this step is marked SKIP and not executed. env steps and matrix steps use [] (no prerequisite). e2e steps typically depend on the env step and the integration steps that establish the data they exercise.

on_fail.description: What happens when this step FAILs. escalate: an environment-class blocker the generator cannot fix by writing code — the evaluator sets next_action: escalate_to_user (use on env steps). skip_dependents: mark every step depending on this one as SKIP, continue with independent steps (default). record: record the FAIL and continue; dependents still run (use only when a fail does not invalidate downstream steps).

path.description: Test path for an integration step backed by a test file.

expected_outcome.description: Optional explicit pass criterion. Default is 'all steps succeed' for env/integration/playwright/manual; 'all checks pass' for matrix.
